dominant_strengths: Confident dark palette with metallic hero render gives the Pro tier a premium, native-Mac feel that aligns with Raycast's brand.
Floating pill nav with balanced spacing and crisp sans-serif typography reads cleanly and stays out of the way of the headline.
Strong typographic hierarchy: large display headline, supporting subcopy, and a clearly weighted CTA with price reassurance below.
dominant_weaknesses: Hero imagery is generic abstract metal — visually pretty but semantically disconnected from 'AI, themes, sync' value props mentioned in copy.
CTA is a muted light pill on dark, lacking the vibrancy or accent color to make 'Compare Plans' feel like the primary action.
Composition leans heavily on centered stack with vast empty lower space before the AI section, making rhythm feel slow and templated.
fix_priorities: Replace abstract hero with a product-anchored visual (UI shard, AI prompt, theme preview) to tie image to message.
Elevate primary CTA with brand red/contrast or micro-interaction to anchor visceral focus.
Tighten vertical rhythm between hero and AI section; introduce a transitional element rather than dead space.
Add subtle motion or parallax on the metallic surface to justify its prominence.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral leads via the metallic hero, behavioral is adequate but the CTA underperforms, and reflective meaning is thin because the imagery doesn't reinforce the Pro narrative.
rationale.intent_fit: It communicates 'Raycast Pro exists and is premium' competently, but underdelivers on showing what Pro actually unlocks at the hero level.
